Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) used to backdoor systems
Data theft leveraged in double extortion ransom schemes
Discoverer: BlackBerry Threat Research and Intelligence Team
Impacted Systems: Educational institutions in the UK and 12 US states
Attack Vector: Exploitation of legacy and seldomly patched systems
